name: bank_transfer
description: Outbound bank transfer to a beneficiary
subject: user
hold: Should the pending bank transfer be held for manual review because the account shows signs of fraud, of account takeover or of money mule activity?

typologies.ato: Account takeover: a person other than the account holder controls the account
typologies.mule: Money mule or fraud ring: the account exists to receive illicit funds and move them on
typologies.legit: Legitimate transfer by the account holder

reasons.new_account: The account was opened very recently
reasons.new_device: The current session uses a device that the account did not use before
reasons.new_beneficiary: The transfer goes to a beneficiary that was added recently
reasons.high_velocity: Money moved through the account unusually fast in the last hours
reasons.device_linked_to_risky_accounts: The device is shared with other users who have fraud reports
